meta.title: Past Programs
meta.tagline: A decade of initiatives that shaped who we are today.
meta.seoDescription: Explore TIDE Foundation's history of educational initiatives — Prerak, BetterEd, CompletEd, and EmpowerEd.

intro: Over the years, TIDE has run a series of deep, grounded educational programs. These initiatives have since evolved or concluded, but their learnings continue to shape everything we do.

programs.name: Prerak
description: Bridging academic learning gap through application-based holistic development and by engaging students in self-learning, peer-learning, project-work and activity-based learning through kits, flashcards, games, and worksheets.

Over time we have engaged in a series of projects including a deep transformation program for whole school improvement (bringing about education of the head, heart, and for empowered schools), alongwith shorter interventions like activity based bridge course, holistic foundational learning, activity-based STEM education, and ABL resource centre.

programs.name: BetterEd
description: Providing life skills education to empower young people with skills (for learning, employability, personal empowerment, and citizenship) to navigate everyday challenges and responsibilities (at home, school, and community).

We ran lifeskills through clubs and social changemaking sessions, weekend life skills classes, support for children with special needs, and daily tuition classes that used value-based learning to bring about holistic education, sustainable development goal workshops alongwith project-based life skills sessions.

programs.name: CompletEd
description: Shaping socially responsible youth leaders through critical dialogue and action on local issues of social justice, along with reflexive self-transformation. Projects focused on promoting social awareness, social entrepreneurship, social emotional learning, critical, divergent, creative thinking, and application-based learning in students from privileged backgrounds to bring about an all-round development.

We ran a series of public talk series recreating a culture of dialogue, independent thinking skills’ workshops with middle school students, research, thinking and soft skill programs for St. Xavier’s college, higher education faculty training sessions, internship and mentoring for engineering students, engaged students in Sustainable Development Goals based drives, and immersed students in grassroots level work through internship and volunteering opportunities.

programs.name: EmpowerEd
description: Empowering educators through communities of practice, sharing effective practices, peer-learning, and action research in rural and alternative schools.

We built communities of holistic educators from across the country, created a means of sharing best classroom practices facilitating peer to peer learning, ran teacher professional development workshops, and set up peer- and self-observation routines.

cta.title: See what we are building today
cta.body: Our current work carries forward the best of these programs. Explore Education for Harmony, Pramaan Resource Centre, and THRIvE Research Centre to see how these learnings live on.
